Object.Description: Ferrogrim's own sentinel, folded down for a Mechanic to throw. It fires three iron shards at a time, and every 3 seconds it slams the ground: the enemies round it are struck and their armor broken, and allies beside it are Armored while it holds. It wears down over time, and when its health runs out it blows apart.

EffectInfo.name: Slam
EffectInfo.description: every 3 secs: 380 to 3.5 sqrs, armor broken for 2 secs; allies within it Armored

Object.Description: A pearl of the Drowned Sanctum's sea. It calls up a substitute that hurls five of Nerissa's tridents and heals you, and the tide answers: three waves roll out from you, each striking your enemies and washing over your allies.

EffectInfo.name: Tide
EffectInfo.description: 3 waves, 0.45 secs apart, to 5.5 sqrs: 220 to enemies, heals allies 60

Object.Description: The Forge Tyrant's mortar. Its shell arcs to where you aim and bursts in a crater of slag, and the sky follows it down: four meteors fall round the crater, while the slag burns on in it.

EffectInfo.name: Shell
EffectInfo.description: to 9 sqrs: 750 to 3 sqrs, paralyzed for 1.5 secs

EffectInfo.name: Slag
EffectInfo.description: 90 every 0.5 secs to 2.5 sqrs, for 3 secs

Object.Description: The Hour Thief's coat, its clock still running. Time stops round you: your enemies slow, you quicken, and the clock's hand sweeps twice round you, cutting all it passes.

EffectInfo.name: Stolen Hours
EffectInfo.description: enemies within 6 sqrs slowed and you Speedy for 3 secs

EffectInfo.name: Clock Hand
EffectInfo.description: 2 sweeps of 0.8 secs, 320 to each enemy within 6 sqrs a sweep

Object.Description: The Sovereign's own lute, strung with the light of the Apex. Its chord inspires your allies, and the aria rings on: four verses, each a wider ring of light from you, harder than the last, and the last a crescendo that breaks armor and drives allies into a fury.

EffectInfo.name: Verses
EffectInfo.description: 4, every 0.6 secs, following you: 250 to 6 sqrs, 320 to 7, 400 to 8

EffectInfo.name: Crescendo
EffectInfo.description: 700 to 9 sqrs, armor broken for 3 secs; allies within 9 sqrs berserk for 3 secs

Object.Description: The Iron Warden, Bastion and all, cut down to a size that fits at your heel. It still holds the line.

Activate.petEffects: Hammer waves and Hammerfall break armor; Hammerfall strikes all enemies within 2.5 tiles of its target; Iron Tempest: a spiral of hammer waves every 10s; Makes you Armored for 2s every 10s

Object.Description: The Tidecaller, with a sea of her own in a shell. The tide still answers to her.

Activate.petEffects: Tide orbs, bubbles and her waves slow; Her waves strike all enemies within 3 tiles of its target; Maelstrom: a whirl of bubbles every 10s; Heals you over 2s every 8s

Object.Description: The Forge Tyrant, still hot from the furnace. It burns whatever stands between you and the loot.

Activate.petEffects: Meteors strike all enemies within 2.2 tiles of its target; Molten Core: a spiral of magma every 10s; Makes you Berserk for 2s every 10s

Object.Description: The Hour Thief, small enough for a pocket watch. It steals a little time for you now and then.

Activate.petEffects: Chrono orbs and the chime slow; The chime strikes all enemies within 2.5 tiles of its target; Reversal: a spiral of gears every 10s; Makes you Speedy for 2s every 8s

Object.Description: The Crucible Sovereign. He built a tower to find the worthy, and it seems he found you.

Activate.petEffects: Void embers break armor for 2s; Gold strikes all enemies within 2.5 tiles of its target; Unbound: fans of void embers every 10s; Makes you Damaging for 2s every 10s
